media-buying.title: Media Buying
media-buying.value: Every pound of ad spend, accountable.
media-buying.description: Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat campaigns built around your margins, not vanity metrics. We test fast, cut waste and scale what sells.
media-buying.intro: We plan, launch and manage paid campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat with one goal: profitable growth. Every campaign starts from your unit economics, so we know what a customer is worth before we spend a pound to acquire one. From there we test creatives and audiences quickly, shift budget toward what converts and report results in plain language.

websites.value: Fast sites that turn visitors into leads.

Everything is built with speed, search visibility and easy updates in mind, so your site keeps performing long after launch.

study.summary: A mobile app for booking a ride or renting a car in Egypt, with one app for riders, car owners and drivers, and a dashboard that runs the whole marketplace.
study.challenge: Renting a car or a driver in Egypt still runs on phone calls and trust. Prices aren't clear upfront, owners can't tell who they're handing their car to, and when the car comes back scratched, nobody has proof of how it left.

study.services: Website, mobile app, dashboard & AI try-on
study.challenge: Buying glasses online is hard. You can't see the frame on your face, and prescription glasses need a lens type, a coating and the numbers from your eye test. Most shops just say "message us on WhatsApp", and the sale gets lost in the chat.
study.solution: We built the whole store around that order. The customer tries the frame on with AI, chooses with or without prescription, picks the lens and coating, and adds a saved prescription. study.summary: A complete learning platform for project management courses: protected video lessons, timed certificate exams, AI-translated questions and verifiable certificates, with a dashboard that runs every course, student and payment.
study.services: Product design, web app, admin dashboard & backend
study.challenge: PMP, CAPM and RMP courses are expensive to produce and easy to pirate. The academy needed more than a video playlist: lessons that can't be downloaded and shared, exams that feel like the real one, and certificates employers can actually check.
study.solution: We built three apps on one backend. Students watch watermarked, protected videos, track their progress, sit timed exams and retake only the questions they got wrong. Passing unlocks a numbered certificate anyone can verify. The team runs courses, payments, exams and emails from a dashboard.
